note: In-memory computing platform (Palo Alto). BCV (Salil Deshpande) entered with the 2013 seed the filings give. Graduation left for the graduation pass.

Reverse-ETL and data activation (San Francisco). 'Bain Capital Ventures' participation in a $12M Series A financing for Hightouch' (the firm's post, 2021-07-21). Mark: the $150M Series D of April 2026 at $2.75B (Pulse 2.0).
Hiring platform (Chicago); $27M round in 2019. Operating; entry from the filings (Michael Krupka, 2014).

Hourly-team management (San Francisco). 'In 2018, Homebase raised $20 million in a series B round led by Bain Capital Ventures' (Wikipedia); BCV's listing gives 2017 (the close). Series C $71M (2021) and D $60M (2024) followed.
Retail search advertising (New York). Acquired by Criteo in 2016 (the firm's listing).
Clinical analytics (Boston). Acquired by UnitedHealth Group's Optum in 2013 (the firm's archive).

Multi-cloud backup (Boston). 'BCV Leads $87.5 Million Series A In HYCU' (the firm's post, 2021-03-30): a Series A by name, whatever its size (COLLECTION.md s6: the label follows what the record calls the round), so the band's Growth and the listing's Growth tag are overruled (decisions.md R2 names this case).
Stock exchange (IEX Group, New York). BCV's listing: 2014, Growth (Matt Harris), the $75M 2014 raise (Traders Magazine); a $75M Series C followed in 2018.
Autonomous trucking (San Francisco). BCV led Ike's $52M Series A (the firm's post 'We Like Ike: Investing In Autonomous Freight', 2019-02-05). Acquired by Nuro in December 2020.
Device identity and fraud risk (Boston). Acquired by American Express (the firm's listing).
Shopper receipt panel (San Francisco). 'We were fortunate to lead the Series A for InfoScout in early 2013' (the firm's post, 2017-06-19); merged into Numerator in 2017.
Traffic and mobility data (Kirkland, WA). BCV listed it from 2006; operating and private.
Market-research software (Waltham, MA), listed by the firm 2003-2013 (Michael Krupka). No sale or later trace found; state unknown. BCV's first round (by 2003) is not named.
Clinical documentation AI (Austin). BCV's listing: 2018, Growth. Acquired by Waystar in 2025.

E-commerce (Jet.com, Hoboken). Walmart bought it for $3B in 2016 (TechCrunch). BCV's listing gives 2014, before the $140M round of February 2015 the filings give; the entry round is taken from the filings pending a source for the 2014 round.
Social game developer; 'Join the company was acquired by GSN (Game Show Network) in December 2011' (the firm's archived page). The filing carries no address and no source read places it.

PEO and payroll (New York). Filed for an IPO in 2021 and withdrew; private. Its only reported unicorn figures are vendor estimates (COLLECTION.md s6 Rule A, ruled on this company), so below_1b. Entry from the filings (Matt Harris on the board since July 2015).
Drug-discount management (Chicago); $28M Series B in June 2020, the round the filings give.

Small-business CRM (Keap, formerly Infusionsoft; Chandler, AZ). BCV listed Infusionsoft from 2014, the year of its $110M growth round, well past its early rounds; the 2018 Form D (Indranil Guha, Merritt Hummer) is a later round. Thryv acquired Keap in 2024 (Thryv's 2025 10-K names BCV's funds).
Warehouse robots (Woburn, MA). 'Bain Capital Ventures led the first institutional investment in Kiva Systems' (the firm's post, 2019-01-15), in 2004. Amazon bought Kiva for $775M in 2012.
Privacy-preserving analytics (Berkeley). Acquired by Snowflake in 2022. BCV's listing gives 2016 (Enrique Salem); the round is not named.

Private benefits exchange (Buffalo). 'Bain Capital Leads $12.6 Million Financing in Liazon' (2011, the round Jeff Crisan's Form D records, in a company incorporated in 2007); Towers Watson bought it in 2013. The round is not named.

Dialysis provider (Mercer Island, WA). 'Bain Capital Ventures seeded and co-founded Liberty Dialysis alongside management in 2002' (the firm's own company page, 2012 capture); the Form D band read a 2010 filing. Merged with Renal Advantage and sold to Fresenius for $1.7B in 2012. Graduation left for the graduation pass.
Reactive application platform (Lightbend, formerly Typesafe; San Francisco); a $25M round led by Dell in 2020. BCV's listing gives 2013; the round is not named.
ML development platform (Lightning AI, formerly Grid.ai; New York). BCV's listing: 2020, Seed; the $40M Series B of June 2022 (AlleyWatch) followed the 2021 Series A.

Shared e-bikes and scooters (Neutron Holdings; San Francisco). BCV's listing gives 2019 (Sarah Smith); Wikipedia records BCV in the $170M Uber-led round of May 2020; both are late rounds, so Growth. IPO on Nasdaq (LIME) in June 2026; market cap pinned in the A/B pass.
Card-linked offers (Boston). Acquired by Collinson Group (the firm's listing). BCV's 2011 round is not named.

Professional network (Sunnyvale). 'In 2008, Bain Capital Ventures and our affiliates provided a substantial investment to LinkedIn' (the firm's own company page, 2012 capture): the $53M Series D of June 2008 that BCV led. IPO 2011; Microsoft bought it in 2016.
Procurement services (Norwalk, CT); FTV Capital invested $180M in 2022 (WSJ). Operating; entry from the filings (2009).
AI tools for teachers (Denver). BCV led the $15M Series A (the firm's post, 2024-06-27), as the filings give.
Office manicure service (New York). Acquired by Elizabeth Arden Red Door Spas (the firm's listing). BCV's 2014 round is not named.

Materials-sample marketplace (Boca Raton, FL; the firm lists New York). 'We are leading a Series B investment in Material Bank' (the firm's post, 2020-04-30). Mark: the $175M round of May 2022 at $1.9B (Refresh Miami); stale beyond 24 months.
Diversity hiring software (Los Angeles). BCV's archive lists it from 2021 (Sarah Smith); the 2022 filing is in a company incorporated in 2017, so the band is withheld and the round is not named.
Healthcare analytics (Emeryville). BCV listed it from 2008 under 'Expansion/Growth Buyout'; JLL Partners acquired it (the firm's listing). Entry taken from the filings as Growth.
Care-management software (Tampa). Acquired by Hearst (the firm's listing). The firm's WordPress-era page tags the 2013 entry 'Growth' (a field not scored for labelling), read as a growth round.
Ad sales intelligence (MediaRadar, New York); the firm lists it as Acquired. BCV's listing gives 2008, six years before the 2014 filing the band read, so the band is withheld; the round is not named.
Fraud management for banks (Concord, MA). 'Acquired by FIS' (the firm's archive). BCV listed it from 2006; the round is not named.
Marketplace software (Paris). 'We are joining forces with Mirakl to lead its $70 million Series C' (the firm's post, 2019-02-28); 'BCV first invested in Mirakl in 2019'.
Payments infrastructure (Cedar Falls, IA). BCV's listing: 2019, Seed; the first partner-anchored Form D (2020) is a later round. The $45M Series B of January 2023 graduates the seed.

AI assistant for enterprise IT (Mountain View). 'When Bain Capital Ventures led Moveworks' Series A in 2019' (the firm's post, 2025-02-24; the listing's 2017 is earlier than any named round). ServiceNow bought Moveworks for $2.85B, closing in December 2025.
Customer data platform (New York). 'Bain Capital Ventures Leads mParticle's $17.5M Series B' (WSJ, 2016-10-13). Rokt acquired it in January 2025.
College planning platform (Austin). Acquired by Blackboard in 2014 (the firm lists it as Acquired). Graduation left for the graduation pass.
Molecular diagnostics (Northbrook, IL). Bain Capital Venture Fund 2005 was a pre-IPO holder (its 2007 S-1); IPO November 2007; Luminex bought it in 2016. The round is not named.

Outpatient cardiology and vascular centres (Houston). Acquired by Fresenius Medical Care (the firm's listing). BCV's listing gives 2012; whether the position was a minority round is not established and the round is not named.
